Concluding technology partnerships with Israeli and Korean companies

Extending a network-solutions portfolio through international partners.

The objective

A Bengaluru-based IT infrastructure company providing complete network solutions wanted to extend its technology portfolio with strategic global partners, complementing its offer for laying optical-fibre networks for enterprises.

Shyam’s contribution

Working with company leadership, Shyam carried out due diligence on several products and opened conversations with an Israeli company and a Korean company. He negotiated the terms, including the commercial buying and resale prices and margins.

The outcome

Agreements were concluded with both companies, about six months after the process began.

Source: Shyam Sundar Pani’s account.

The experience this brings

Assessing potential partners’ products and negotiating the commercial terms of cross-border technology partnerships.

Related services

  • Develop workable agreements
  • Find and develop suitable partnerships
  • Develop new offers together

Linked as transferable experience, not as a Japan–India assignment.
